type:
Adverb
Pronunciation: /ob-vee-us-lee/
Definition: In a way that is easy to see or understand.
Grammar: Used to emphasize that something is clear.
Usage: Formal, Informal
Synonyms: clearly, evidently, plainly
Examples:
• He was obviously tired.
• Obviously, we need to plan ahead.
